column2: [intro]
I’ve got a talent, I’m a rockstar,
But when I sing, it’s a nightmare by far.
My audience covers their ears,
And here I am, arms in the air, full of cheers.
I sing, I sing so off-key,
No one gets it, it's pure chaos, you see.
But it doesn’t matter, I’m having fun,
'Cause I’m the queen of off-key, everyone!
I’ve got gold records, thousands of fans,
But when I open my mouth, it’s clear, it’s not grand.
My agent begs me to stop the show,
But I keep on going, embracing the flow.
I sing, I sing so off-key,
No one gets it, it’s pure chaos, you see.
But it doesn’t matter, I’m having fun,
'Cause I’m the queen of off-key, everyone!
[ solo ]
I’m unique, I’m a diva,
My style is false notes, that’s my schema.
While the world demands perfection,
I sing off-key, it's my own reflection.
[outro]
